checklist.evidence: Date from `DateTimeOriginal`, then `CreateDate`, otherwise skip and report the file
a file with no EXIF date should be left alone rather than guessed
Same-second collisions get `_01`, `_02`, … in `SubSecTimeOriginal` order, then by original name
Default mode: dry run; real renames need `--apply` plus a confirmation prompt
Rename each file atomically without ever overwriting: hard-link then unlink on POSIX, `os.rename` on Windows (it fails if the target exists)
Write each journal entry and flush it to disk before doing that rename… `undo <run-id>` and `resume <run-id>`
Camera-local time… Time-zone normalization (`OffsetTimeOriginal`, GPS time). Pulled forward if you mix photos taken in different time zones
rename `.xmp`, `.aae`, and Live Photo `.mov` files that share the photo's base name together with it
Name format `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.ext`: hyphens because Windows forbids colons, and the original extension is kept
